description: Searches a free library of AI video prompts that really worked, each published next to the video it produced. Takes a plain-language description of a video (subject, mood, style, shot) in any language; English gives the closest matches. Returns the prompts that fit, best first, each with how well it fits (strong, possible or weak), its page, its video, its model and its creator. The full text of a prompt comes from fetch.

category.description: Only this category, as a slug from list_options.

language.description: Language of the user, as a code such as fr, es, ja, zh, zh-tw (50 languages). Titles, summaries and links come in this language, and fetch adds the translated prompt. Defaults to en.

model.description: Only prompts made with this video model, for example "veo", "seedance" or "Kling". See list_options.

query.description: What the user wants to make, for example "a slow-motion perfume ad" or "documentaire sur la Corée filmé au caméscope". Leave empty to get the most liked prompts for the filters.

technique.description: Only prompts using this technique, as a slug from list_options, for example "dolly-in".

name: search
title: Find video prompts
